articles.title: Reliance Industries among 8 stocks showing RSI Trending Up
Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Jio Platforms, M&M, CDSL, ITC, NTPC, IOCL and Hero MotoCorp
Reliance Industries eyes growth boost from O2C, retail and Jio businesses
Market wrap: RIL, Tata Steel, Infosys, ICICI Bank top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Monday
Reliance Industries shares rally 6% after Q2 results. Here’s why Jefferies, others analysts see up to 47% upside

article_briefs.brief: The article notes that Reliance Industries was among eight Nifty 500 stocks whose RSI crossed above 50, indicating an uptrend signal per StockEdge's scan.
Reliance Industries reported a 41% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 25,548 crore for the September quarter, as part of a broader earnings focus on November 2.

Reliance's September‑quarter revenue grew 27.8% YoY to ₹3.6 lakh crore; O2C EBITDA jumped 67.9% to ₹25,203 crore (about 40% of total EBITDA), while retail EBITDA fell 10.2% YoY to ₹6,120 crore. Jio Platforms' subscriber base rose 7.1% YoY to 542.4 million, 5G users increased to 55.3% from 46.3%, and ARPU rose to ₹218.8 from ₹211.4.
Market wrap highlighted broad market gains, with the Nifty Oil & Gas index up nearly 6% and the Nifty Metal index up over 3%, while other indices showed mixed moves.

Reliance's Q2 results showed revenue from operations up 29% YoY to Rs 3.32 lakh crore; O2C EBITDA surged 68% YoY to a record Rs 25,203 crore, offsetting a 6% miss in retail EBITDA. Analysts projected upside potentials of 34‑47% and noted O2C profitability expected to remain elevated.

key_points.text: Reliance reported a 41% YoY increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 25,548 crore for the September quarter.
September‑quarter revenue grew 27.8% YoY to ₹3.6 lakh crore, driven by O2C EBITDA rising 67.9% YoY to ₹25,203 crore (≈40% of total EBITDA) while retail EBITDA declined 10.2% YoY to ₹6,120 crore.
Q2 results showed revenue from operations up 29% YoY to Rs 3.32 lakh crore and O2C EBITDA up 68% YoY to a record Rs 25,203 crore, offsetting a 6% miss in retail EBITDA.
Jio Platforms' subscriber base grew 7.1% YoY to 542.4 million, 5G user share rose to 55.3% from 46.3%, and ARPU increased to ₹218.8 from ₹211.4.
Analysts (Jefferies) see potential upside of up to 47% on Reliance stock, citing strong O2C performance and expectations of continued profitability; retail challenges noted.
Nomura cut its target price but highlighted O2C EBITDA of Rs 25,200 crore versus its estimate of Rs 20,300 crore, underscoring the segment's record performance.

industry_context.text: The Nifty Oil & Gas index surged nearly 6%, indicating strong sector momentum that could benefit Reliance's oil‑to‑chemicals business.
The Nifty Metal index rallied more than 3% while other sector indices showed mixed performance, reflecting broader market dynamics.
